latest_release.name: v2.12.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* feat: agentscript by @Booyaka101 in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4483
* docs(astro): update language-tools URLs by @tdhuan in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4485
* docs(astro): document TypeScript 7.x limitation and npm-global fallback example by @tdhuan in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4486
* corrected roslyn_ls.lua call to .iter to take a table as expected by @chepeniv in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4487
* feat(oxfmt): enable for svelte by @igorlfs in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4488
* docs(emmylua_ls): remove irrelevant issue link by @memchr in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4490
* fix(ols): reuse existing client when opening libraries by @mikejmcguirk in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4491
* fix(vhdl_ls): require workspace by @jgonmor16 in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4494
* feat: pkl by @oresttokovenko in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4495
* fix(verible): add verible.filelist as root marker by @jgonmor16 in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4498
* feat: tsc by @rliebz in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4493
* fix(julials): fix the default setup by @fredrikekre in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4499
* feat(tsc): enable CodeLens by @lan1812783 in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4501
* fix(vhdl_ls): drop .vhdl_ls.toml root marker by @jgonmor16 in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4506
* fix(tsc): skip binaries that do not support --lsp by @nitaicharan in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4505
* Add support for Symfony LSP by @fabpot in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4507
* fix(slang-server): Properly detect different workspaces in the same git repo by @ser-gik in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4508
* feat: php_lsp by @jorgsowa in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4489
* fix(oxc): allow oxfmt and oxlint to run in single-file mode by @marcuscaisey in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4509
* fix(ols): add error handling for 'odin root' command by @Silzinc in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4511
* feat: ms_terraform_lsp by @tobiassen in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4510
* feat: rust_glancer by @h-michael in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4512
* notify the user if rustc/cargo are missing instead of throwing an error (v2) by @cornservant in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4500
* fix(ast_grep): attach to shell buffers by @etrobert in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4514
* powershell_es: validate shell, disable profile loading by @Konstantin-Glukhov in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4513
* fix(esbonio): use version 2 CLI by @viktorashi in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4516
* fix(util): use vim.uv for fs_stat by @khaneliman in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4519
* fix(util): replace undefined variable by @chernetskyi in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4520
* feat(clice): add clice support by @Crysthamus in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4522
* feat: Update TypeScript version in installation instructions by @Its-Just-Nans in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4517
* perf: defer requiring util until legacy branch by @chernetskyi in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4521
* refactor: move legacy-only code below version check by @chernetskyi in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4523
* fix(robotcode): drop non-existent resource filetype by @dawidd6 in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4526
* fix(powershell_es): incorrect script path in command by @sharpchen in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4527
* fix(phpantom_lsp): add blade as supported filetype by @job79 in https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pul
